featured_reviews.review_text:
What happened here was genuinely dangerous and I refuse to stay silent.

Over a month ago I arrived 15 minutes late and the dentist’s entire demeanor shifted , cold, dismissive, and more offended by my timing than concerned about my pain. She barely examined me, took no proper X-rays barely one for a random tooth, and within minutes told me I needed a root canal. She completed it a week later, then sent me home for capping.

Almost 2 weeks in from the first visit When I returned for the capping , I told her clearly my mouth was in extreme pain and , something was very wrong. Her response? “You bit your cheek.” She sent me home. Days later I couldn’t open my mouth, couldn’t eat, couldn’t speak, couldn’t work and my swelling was horrific. I was on painkillers every single day for nearly three weeks now.  I had to go back in that state for the final capping of my root canal before she finally admitted I had developed an abscess that had spread to my cheek. Something she should have caught weeks earlier if she had actually listened to me.

I’ve since switched dentists. My new doctor confirmed that the aggressive tooth extractions she was pushing were completely unnecessary at that moment as it was extremely infected due to her ignorance of the problem at hand. I’ve improved more in one week with him than in an entire month with her.

This isn’t a bad experience. This is medical negligence. Please do not come here.

featured_reviews.name: Robert Muir
featured_reviews.review_text: I can’t praise The White Tusk team enough, what a relaxing experience even though I was having extractions and implants during my first visit, so relaxing that I fell asleep during one session. On my return 8 months later for completion of my dental work I was so looking forward to my appointments. From day one the service and professionalism was every bit as good as my initial visit, my implants healed beautifully and after several fittings and adjustments I have the perfect smile. Our scheduled days and times allowed us to spend time doing other things like visiting the many tourist attractions. Many thanks to Dr Vinita and your team for the excellent service you provided, I have no hesitation in recommending The White Tusk for dental work. I’m back home in Scotland and the feedback I’ve received from my family and friends has been so positive, they mention how natural my teeth look in colour and shape, this is so satisfying to hear.
